geometry_edits.rationale: Rotate the notch to face the verified access edge, making the public threshold align with site access.
Increase the width of the ground carve to improve public void legibility at the frontage.
Raise the carving to strengthen the sectionally active threshold while keeping the mass coherent.

graph_edits.rationale: Align the ground threshold notch to the verified primary road frontage/access edge so the public void reads as an access response rather than a generic cut.
Broaden the entry seam slightly to strengthen the legibility of the public ground response without destroying the dominant mass.
Extend the notch vertically so the ground carving participates more clearly in section and supports an active threshold.

rationale: The candidate reads coherently in all four views as one dominant stepped mass with a clear main/support relationship. It responds to the parcel without merely filling the box, and the visible stair-step profile is not arbitrary: it creates a controlled upper hierarchy with a compact base. The road frontage edge is acknowledged, but only weakly; the ground response is more of a small notch/offset than a strongly public court, so void_publicness is moderate rather than strong. The form is plausible for neighborhood living / mixed-use because it can support an active ground threshold and layered upper massing, though the section remains somewhat generic and the roof/void logic is not yet especially rich. No visible view collision or one-view-only coherence issue is present.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: More tower-like and taller than this neighborhood-living candidate; do not copy the vertical emphasis.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Stepped/tapered upper mass over a clearer lower datum; useful as a precedent for hierarchy and skyline resolution.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: The candidate is more sectional and stacked; the reference is simpler and more pavilion-like.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Compact commercial mass with a legible ground threshold and a small attached vertical element; transferable as active-edge logic.

warnings: Access response is legible but underdeveloped relative to the verified road edge.
The section could better articulate a stronger public void or terrace to support the program contract.
Stepped massing is coherent, but avoid drifting into decorative tiering in the next iteration.
